description: Add a talking 3D AI avatar to a web app with the Perxona Connect API and the <sv-presenter> Presenter SDK web component: avatars, scenes, voices, lip-sync, emotions and motions, with an Express sample and tools.
rules: Keep the secret Connect API key on the server; only the publishable key may reach the browser.
Load the Presenter module once from the PRESENTER_URL your server supplies, declare <sv-presenter> in the DOM, then call initializeWithConnectKey() before present().
Wait for the presenter to reach Ready before calling present(); check PresentationResult.success and its code/message on failure.
Pick avatar, scene and voice IDs from the catalog endpoints rather than hardcoding them in production.
